scope: Representative Gaussian pilot only; not full transform-grid or prerequisite certification

methods.samplers: Exact-score affine Heun ODE and Euler-Maruyama naive/fixed; regression-tested against psdt.sample for isotropic models
methods.reference: Independent adaptive DOP853 reverse mean/covariance ODE
methods.monte_carlo: Compare particles to the exact discrete Gaussian law, separating Monte Carlo fluctuations from integration bias
methods.coupling: Same exact terminal draw at all K; sum fine Brownian increments for coarse steps; use A L and shared increments for transported paths
methods.Arm_A: Pure transport, not locally recomputed clipping
methods.Arm_B: Locally computed spectral clipping in re-isotropized coordinates; path check transports that entire sampler back
methods.particle_refinement: Nested particle prefixes; independent seeds are replicates. No monotonic-error requirement for individual random draws.
methods.rate_sweep: Fixed absolute rates across arms; each rate has its own shared horizon T=log(sigmaT/sigma0)/r and exact sigmaT=40

limitations: Does not clear deterministic or forward-feasibility prerequisites.
Does not assess mixture sampling, learned scores, or approximate terminal priors.
Representative identity and squeezes only, including condition number 4, the largest condition number in the listed primary controls.
Below-threshold naive bias is measured, not assumed universally nonzero.
